proves.claim: with health.derivedState on and a table current for main, an item the table marks stale goes back to its lane and a fresh one is offered

cli.io-landing-pull.table-staleness-reop.why: Without it landing could keep recomputing freshness per item from git, or ignore a stale verdict the table already holds.

proves.claim: with a table swept at an older main, or with the setting off, freshness is computed as on main

cli.io-landing-pull.table-not-current-co.why: Without it a table swept at another commit could mark an item stale or fresh for a main it does not describe.

proves.claim: offerPulledLanding hands the table verdicts to withoutStaleVerdicts, so a current table offers the same items with fewer git starts

cli.io-landing-pull.table-wired-into-off.why: Without it the table would exist and show would read it while the lander still ran a git history per item.
